title: Ordered horizontal faces of a single principal-open subset
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f:Fin r → A and J an integer cochain complex of module sheaves on Spec A. Use the union V, principal opens D_T, section transport, subset coordinates, insertion, and increasing tuple of [def-sc-principal-open-cech-subset-insertion], and the ordered Cech differential and double complex K of [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] for U_i=V⁻¹D(f_i). Let H forget modules over the global ring of V to additive groups. Suppose hle gives D_T≤D_(T erase j), and he gives n+1-|T erase j|=n+2-|T| for j∈T. Fix n, a nonempty subset S₀, and a section x of J^(n+1-|S₀|) on D_(S₀). Put p=|S₀|-1, q=n+1-|S₀|, P the global-ring module presheaf of J^q restricted to V, L its nonnegative ordered Cech complex, and e:(K.X(p+1)).X q ≅ L.X(p+1) its extension isomorphism. For every hdeg:(p+1)+q=n+1, apply d:L.X p→L.X(p+1) to the tuple vector supported at the enumeration of S₀ with value the transported section x. Then apply e inverse and include that bidegree into total degree n+1. The result equals subset insertion in degree n+1 of the coordinates whose T component is the sum over j∈T with nonempty T erase j of (-1) raised to the number of i∈T below j, times restriction along hle of the he-transport of (Pi.single S₀ x)_(T erase j). Empty deletions contribute zero.

proof.text: Apply principalSubsetRowReassembly to the target ordered row p+1 with its differential vector and the stated signed subset family. The supplied hdeg is its total-degree equation.

For a subset S of cardinality different from p+2, prove every signed term is zero. If the deletion is empty it is zero by definition. Otherwise equality S erase j=S0 would imply card(S)=card(S0)+1=p+2 by card_erase_of_mem and nonemptiness of S0. Thus the source subset singleton is zero, and both coefficient maps preserve zero.

On a subset of cardinality p+2, principalSubsetHorizontalFaceCoordinate gives exactly the heterogeneous equality required by row reassembly. The latter then identifies the row inclusion with the full subset insertion.

lean.statement:
theorem principalSubsetHorizontalFaces
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex (Spec (.of A)).Modules ℤ) :
    let V := principalSubsetUnion A r f
    let U : Fin r → V.toScheme.Opens := fun i ↦ V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)
    let K := (alternatingCechDoubleFunctor U).obj (principalSubsetRestriction A r f J)
    let H := forget₂
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤))) AddCommGrpCat
    let D := principalSubsetOpen A r f
    ∀ (hle : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), D S ≤ D (S.erase j))
      (he : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), j ∈ S → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n + 1 - ((S.erase j).card : ℤ) = n + 1 + 1 - (S.card : ℤ))
      (n : ℤ) (S₀ : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty})
      (x : (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 - (S₀.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj
        (op (D S₀.val))),
      let p := S₀.val.card - 1
      let q := n + 1 - (S₀.val.card : ℤ)
      let P := alternatingCechModulePresheaf.obj ((principalSubsetRestriction A r f J).X q)
      let L := alternatingCechComplex U P
      let e : (K.X ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).X q ≅ L.X (p + 1) :=
        L.extendXIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat rfl
      ∀ (hdeg : ComplexShape.π (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ), q) = n + 1),
      (H.map (e.inv ≫ K.ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) q (n + 1) hdeg))
        ((alternatingCechDifferential U P p).hom
          (Pi.single (principalSubsetTuple r S₀)
            ((principalSubsetSectionTransport A r f (J.X q) S₀).hom x))) =
      principalSubsetInsertion A r f J (n + 1) (fun S ↦
          ∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val)))
                    ((Pi.single S₀ x : principalSubsetCoordinates A r f J n)
                      ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0)
